scope: Compilation and PDF inspection of the current unmodified manuscript; separate from the Lean replay and semantic correspondence review.

engine.name: Tectonic
engine.source_document_mode: Native REVTeX 4.2 branch, with all original mathematical content and color definitions retained.
engine.trust_boundary: Official prebuilt Tectonic executable and its downloaded TeX bundle; neither engine nor bundle rebuilt from source.

execution.cache_and_build_outputs: Isolated under work/latex-check in the session workspace; no repository or Lean dependency files were changed.

diagnostics.bibliography_explanation: The manuscript provides 45 entries directly in thebibliography. REVTeX also causes a BibTeX run on its generated notes database, producing 45 missing-database-entry warnings and one style warning. The final TeX pass has no undefined citations or references, and the PDF contains the manually supplied bibliography.
diagnostics.text_extraction_limit: pypdf reported that optional fontTools was unavailable for some mathematical Type1 encodings. Text extraction was used only as a supplementary unresolved-marker check; rendering was inspected separately.
environment_messages: Fontconfig error: Cannot load default config file: No such file: (null)
Fontconfig error: No writable cache directories
diagnostics.environment_message_scope: These Tectonic environment messages also occur on the baseline. They did not stop compilation or prevent bundled fonts from rendering.

baseline_comparison.mode: Separate copied source and output directory; same engine and --only-cached bundle resources.
baseline_comparison.conclusion: The retained TeX and BibTeX warnings already occur in the pre-revision manuscript under the same engine.

visual_inspection.result: No visible clipping, overlapping content, or black glyph boxes on the inspected renders. The revised abstract, availability reference, and noise convention display normally.
visual_inspection.scope: Layout review and spot checks; not an independent verification of every mathematical glyph or handwritten proof.

archive_policy: Logs are copied without alteration. Download response headers and signed download URLs are excluded. The summary uses repository-relative paths and contains no local account path.
skills_used: pdf:pdf for rendering and visual inspection
proj_005_skill_humanizer for the final prose pass
